title: Chapter 143 Concubine Snow Pavilion
content:
Chapter 143 Concubine Snow Pavilion

In the evening, although the sun has set in the west, the moon is on the tip of the mountain. But this bustling city still hasn't stopped its hustle and bustle.

Although many ordinary people went home to sleep peacefully, more high-ranking officials and dignitaries, such as Wang Qing and nobles, came out for activities.

I saw Zuixian downstairs, the avenue wide enough for five carriages to pass side by side. At this moment, cars are coming and going, and the sound of wooden wheels rolling over the hard stone slabs can be heard endlessly.

"Is this the country of Yan? Although it has reached the critical moment of national ruin and family destruction, it is still so extravagant and expensive. In the middle of the night, it is still singing and singing Yanyu!" Zhong Yu thought of the current wars in the six countries of the world. The trend of Qin's domination of the world has been revealed.

However, all countries still took the opportunity to strive for strength, but they are drunk now, and they don't care about it.

"The king of Yan is fatuous and likes to enjoy himself. His younger brother, Lord Yan Chun, is in charge of power and politics, colludes with ministers, and brings chaos to the government. The entire upper class is rotten like this. What is good at the top is effective at the bottom. The state of Yan is now in a state of extravagance. It's no wonder!" Zhao Yun, who was always worried about government affairs, couldn't help but sigh slightly when he saw the scene of Yan.

"Isn't this better? The country of Yan is worse, and there are more jesters. In the future, it will be easier for me to level this land!" Zhong Yu sneered, but he thought that he would attack and destroy the land in the future. What a scene in Yan Kingdom!

After finishing speaking, he got up, arranged the hem of his clothes left and right, adjusted his image a little, and then walked out the door.

"As for now, let's take a look at the bustling night scene of the Yan Kingdom. It's hard to come out, how can we miss the scenery of the North Country!"

Hearing this, Zhao Yun's fourth general and some hidden guards followed him.

All the way through the bustling streets, the exquisite carriage prepared by the author Zuixianlou, the wheels sizzling on the bluestone floor, walked towards the famous place of fireworks in the country of Yan.

In front of the door of Feixue Pavilion, several scantily clad women were braving the bleak night, beckoning customers passing by with smiles and smiles.

"Here we are, this is the most famous dance hall in the country of Yan. People who are good at dancing from all over the world gather here. It can be said that you can see most of the world's dances here!" Zhong Yu lifted the curtain beside the carriage and walked towards the carriage. Zhao Yun and others inside introduced.

"Is the best dancer in the world that my lord said is also here?" Zhang Fei asked doubtfully.

He got up and got off the carriage, and walked into the hall of Feixue Pavilion under the expectant eyes of the group of women.

"That's right, she is not only the world's number one dancer, but also a rare and stunning beauty. What is even more surprising is that she is also a second-rate master in the late stages of the world, and she may be promoted in a few years. A first-class existence." Zhong Yu smiled, walked towards his subordinates, and popularized the main characters of Qin Shimingyue.

"Really? In this way, this woman is indeed not simple. She is outstanding in talent and appearance, but also has good martial arts!" Zhao Yun was a little surprised.

"That's right, this Feixue Pavilion, besides such a strange woman, also has a peerless piano player that you have definitely heard of, Gao Jianli!" Zhong Yu teased another name that surprised Zhao Yun and others .

"Gao Jianli, could it be that the qin master Gao Jianli who assassinated King Qin Yingzheng, failed in the end and was bestowed to death by King Qin? I heard that he was a blind man, and he deliberately stabbed himself blind before entering the Qin Palace, in order to win the favor of Yingzheng." Trust, I don’t know if it’s true or not?” Zhang Fei, who was particularly fond of these anecdotes about literati and refined guests, was showing off his little bit of knowledge.

"In your world, Gao Jianli is a blind man, a bad old man. There is nothing wrong with that. But in this world, Gao Jianli is a handsome guy, and he has outstanding martial arts all his life. He is a top master who has just broken through to the top. He is nothing. Blind man, on the contrary, is a very threatening figure, compared with him, his outstanding piano skills become insignificant!" Zhong Yu's teasing moved Zhang Fei's show off.

"Oh, he is a first-class master of the fourth level. I feel a little itchy when I hear this. If I have a chance, I must fight against him, so that I can taste the pain of my skill!" Hearing that Gao Jianli's martial arts is very high , but Zhang Fei's interest became even higher. A martial idiot, he can't wait to fight Gao Jianli to see who wins.

"In addition to martial arts, Gao Jianli also holds a famous sword in Jiang Hu's hand that everyone yearns for. The Shuihan Sword, which ranks seventh in the Fengbeard Sword Manual, was forged by Master Xu of the Mohist School. It is a sword. An extremely terrifying weapon for killing!" When mentioning the Shuihan Sword, Zhong Yu also sighed slightly.

He didn't have a handy weapon before, but when the system was there, he wanted to exchange it for one. But I found that the price of all the weapons that suit me is too high, and the effort is not directly proportional to the gain, so I can only reluctantly give up.

However, now is not without chance. It is still stored in the treasury of the Chu Palace, and the Tianwen Sword has not been obtained by Qin Wang Yingzheng. Isn't the weapon ranked number one in the sword manual a sword that suits his status very well?

"Water Cold Sword, really makes people yearn for it!" After Zhao Yun heard it, his expression was leisurely, obviously thinking about what kind of sword it was that could make his lord admire him so much.

Heroes love beauties, generals love swords.

Zhao Yun is no exception. During the Three Kingdoms period, he once snatched Cao Cao's Qinghong Sword, and showed great enthusiasm in his hands, accompanying him invincible on the battlefield.

It's just that, in this mythical world of Qinshi Mingyue, or even the previous main world, the magic weapon he once thought was like broken copper and iron, not worth mentioning.

Now he is still using that bronze sword that is extremely unsuitable and not suitable for his own strength, and he has long been extremely uncomfortable.

Hearing these famous swords at this moment, he couldn't help feeling something.

"That's right, if you want me, Old Zhang, to go and beat up that Gao Jianli and grab his Shuihan Sword, wouldn't it be just right? How can you use it like this mother-in-law, as if you can't let it go!" As expected, Zhang Fei is reckless. His temperament is hard to change, and he just beats, smashes and grabs at every turn. But it looks like his wife was snatched.

"No, I was wondering if I could subdue this Gao Jianli? Not to mention his high martial arts skills, he also has an excellent piano skill, which is brought with him, and when he is bored, he can also ask him to play a few tunes when he is bored. Is it a realm?" As he talked, he began to imagine how special it would be after he subdued Gao Jianli.

"But according to what the lord said, this Gao Jianli seems to be a strong man, and he is also a strong man with a cold personality. How can such a person be easily subdued?" Zhao Yun was a little puzzled.

"No, if it was any other time, he would definitely be difficult to subdue. But it's different now, he has a bond, and with this bond, it will be much easier to subdue him!" Zhong Yu said slowly The idea is to hang the appetite of Zhao Yun and others, with a mysterious smile.
